adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `basePath(store, type)` in `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6` from checking `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type)` to `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-'))`, which is behavior-bearing for any model type strings containing underscores and directly affects whether requests are prefixed with `/admin/`. The only JS tests modified/added in this diff (`test/javascripts/models/store-test.js.es6` plus pretender data) cover `_hydrateEmbedded` (including the new plural `_ids` handling) and do not exercise adapter URL/basePath selection or admin-prefix routing.
